cand.title: European Lattice Field Theory Community Meeting & Workshop on Lattice Field Theory and AI
cand.organizationName: European Lattice Field Theory community, supported by Hadron 2030 and CERN Theory
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Antonio Rago and Gert Aarts are both officially listed 2027 chairpersons. They are verified organizer contacts, not verified hotel buyers: Rago is a useful community-organizing referral and Aarts a scientific-chair referral for identifying the logistics lead. Neither is shown to control accommodation procurement. The published operational route is THworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch. Ask this secretariat to identify the named accommodation decision-maker before treating either chair as a contracting buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 31 March–2 April 2027, 08:00 start / 18:00 finish, Europe/Zurich, CERN, Meyrin, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. The event root calls it “EuroLFT Town Hall meeting & Workshop on Lattice Field Theory and AI”; the /overview page retains the supplied European Lattice Field Theory Community Meeting title. These are the same event ID, dates, venue and chairpersons, not separate editions. The community meeting runs 31 March–1 April morning; the AI workshop runs 1 April afternoon–2 April. No later edition through June 2028 was found officially announced.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: conditional secondary lodging fit, weak meeting-replacement fit. YOTEL’s Founex/La Côte airport-side location and hybrid-capable meeting spaces could support a separately requested small working session, dinner or off-site accommodation; the published programme itself is already at CERN. The hotel advertises six meeting spaces, 23–352 sqm, up to 250 delegates, but event attendance and room demand are unpublished, so capacity compatibility cannot be established. Treat the supplied 20–120-room band as a sales constraint, not a demand estimate; there is no basis for a 237-room buyout. This is a campus-access/cost/convenience proposition, not a resort-led or downtown-congress opportunity. A dependable hotel–CERN transfer plan must be established before pitching lodging.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: CERN, 4/3-006 – TH Conference Room, Building 4. Event directions identify the CERN main entrance as Esplanade des Particules 1, 1217 Meyrin, Switzerland. Territory classification: Meyrin / Geneva Airport-side CERN campus, Canton of Geneva; not downtown Geneva, Founex/Nyon/La Côte, or Lausanne. This is a confirmed institutional meeting venue, not a hotel. No signed venue contract was inspected; the official venue listing is the commitment evidence.
findings.historicalRotation: EuroLFT identifies itself as formerly EuroLAT. A contemporaneous presentation dated 28–29 April 2025 reports a EuroLat founding meeting on 3–4 April at Southern Denmark University. Assigning 2025 to those founding-meeting dates is a contextual inference from the presentation, not a fully dated event listing. This is a related network predecessor, not a verified prior edition of the combined 2027 AI workshop. No historical hotel or established destination-rotation sequence was verified. A July 2025 Lattice Hadron Physics proposal envisages a yearly EuroLat town meeting; the earlier report says “periodic (maybe annual)”. These establish intentions, not demonstrated annual recurrence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for this edition. The edition-specific directions say: “If you have a room in the hostel and arrive on Sunday evening, the guards at the CERN main entrance (B) will have your name on the guest list. Please bring your reservation confirmation.” They identify hostel buildings 38, 39 and 41. This is conditional logistical guidance, not evidence of a reserved block, available inventory or a mandated booking channel. The Sunday-arrival wording does not establish the required arrival date for this Wednesday-start event. Only CERN Hostel is mentioned in the reviewed edition-specific material; no commercial hotel is named. No edition-specific housing bureau, open RFP, room allocation, hotel booking link, negotiated rate or room-block deadline was found. Other CERN workshops’ hostel blocks and nearby-hotel lists must not be imported into this edition.
findings.organizationStructure: An academic/research community event, not a scaling-company event. EuroLFT describes itself as the body representing the European lattice field theory community, formerly EuroLAT. The event is supported by Hadron 2030 and CERN Theory and hosted at CERN, with a named scientific-chair committee and CERN Theory workshop secretariat support. No separate incorporated association status, appointed PCO/DMC, commercial agency or housing bureau was verified. Supporter, host, organizer and lodging buyer should remain distinct.
findings.competitiveLimitations: CERN Hostel is explicitly referenced but no edition-specific allocation or occupancy is published. This does not prove lodging is committed elsewhere, nor that hostel overflow exists. The official directions describe airport-to-CERN public transport via Blandonnet and tram 18 access from Cornavin, giving those access patterns a documented convenience advantage. YOTEL’s advertised free shuttle serves Geneva Airport in morning/evening periods and cannot be pre-booked; it is not evidence of hotel–CERN event transport. No sourced overflow, competitor sell-out, room shortage, event budget or incumbent commercial hotel was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact THworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch now, referencing event 1742694 and 31 March–2 April 2027. Ask for the named lodging/logistics lead, expected nonlocal attendees, actual arrival/departure pattern, whether CERN Hostel rooms are reserved, any external-hotel referrals or blocks, individual versus centralized payment, budget and daily CERN transport requirements. Request an introduction to Antonio Rago or Gert Aarts only if scientific-organizer sponsorship is needed. Offer a conditional lodging-and-transfer discussion; do not promise a CERN shuttle or quote a forecast room block. Pursue a dinner or small side meeting only if separately requested. If no unmet accommodation need exists, move to low-priority future-relationship development rather than an active 2027 hotel-sourcing lead.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the currently announced 2027 edition, the core meeting venue is confirmed at CERN and should not be sold as an open venue lead. Hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed, not open. The overview says registration is expected to open in mid-November 2026 and there is no registration fee; the reviewed registration page shows no available forms. No attendance count follows from that status. Lodging, dinner or side-meeting access is only a qualification hypothesis pending organizer confirmation.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: maintain a research-community relationship for future small workshops or independently sourced room needs, rather than claiming a recurring hotel rotation. Proposed yearly town meetings offer a relationship rationale only; no next-cycle dates, city, venue or open tender beyond the confirmed 2027 event were found. A future off-campus meeting is possible only if the organizers choose that model and disclose suitable size, budget and transport needs.
